# Holbæk Pædiatri

Holbæk Pædiatri is a pediatric department in Denmark that participates in the DANIBD registry, which monitors diagnostic workup of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients across Danish hospitals and regions [^src1].

The department's performance on indicator 1b—which measures complete diagnostic workup (including gastroscopy, colonoscopy, and MR imaging or capsule endoscopy) for children and young people with IBD—stands at 60% compliance [^src1]. This falls short of the national target of 69%, which was achieved across Denmark in the period covered by the DANIBD 2024 audit [^src1]. The indicator 1b workup rate at Holbæk Pædiatri (60%, based on 3 of 5 cases) represents a notable gap, though the small sample size (5 cases) reflects the department's limited caseload for newly diagnosed pediatric IBD [^src1]. 

In a separate measurement on an unspecified indicator, Holbæk Pædiatri recorded 0 of 5 cases, though the specific indicator measured is not detailed in the available documentation [^src2].

The DANIBD registry itself covers all five Danish regions and aims to ensure that children and young people receive complete diagnostic assessment when IBD is first identified. Variation in compliance across departments and regions—as illustrated by Holbæk Pædiatri's 60% rate—is part of the broader discussion within the registry about why some centers fall short of targets and what improvements are needed ahead of the next audit scheduled for 2026 [^src1].
